event: US jobs report Fri 6 Nov 15:30 SAST (65k expected vs 29k)

bullets.title: Holding gains
bullets.text: Gold is near 4,125, a two-week high, keeping most of Wednesday's 3%+ jump, but it has not broken 4,135-4,146 yet.

bullets.title: Dollar weak
bullets.text: DXY is near 101.3 and the US 10-year yield near 4.87% after Democrats won Congress. That helps gold.

bullets.title: Headwind
bullets.text: Markets still price about 79-82% odds of a Fed hike in December (sources differ). That caps rallies.

bullets.title: BoE hiked
bullets.text: The Bank of England raised rates to 4.00% at 14:00 SAST, as expected; gold showed no big reaction in the reports found.

bullets.title: Oil steadier
bullets.text: Brent is near $94-95 after Wednesday's ~9% drop on US-Iran peace hopes, so the inflation relief has paused.

bullets.title: Claims unknown
bullets.text: US jobless claims came out at 15:30 SAST today; the result was not in any source found (UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Friday's test
bullets.text: The jobs report is Friday 15:30 SAST: 65k jobs and 4.2% unemployment expected. Strong numbers can pull gold toward 4,000.
